profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Software Engineer with over 10 years of experience at GitHub and Google, with a passion for open source.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Android – Google Play Store

positions.title: Infrastructure Engineer
positions.description: Site Reliability Engineer

positions.title: Application Engineer - Product
positions.description: Worked on GitHub Pages and GitHub Actions.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Platform)
positions.description: I help build things on the web, including, but not limited to, https://vsco.co, and https://grid.vsco.co.

positions.title: Consultant - GitHub Pages
positions.description:
As a consultant with GitHub, Inc., I am working closely with @github/pages team on a part-time basis to level up the Pages experience and infrastructure for a brighter world. http://pages.github.com

Note: I am not a GitHub employee.

positions.title: Web Team Intern
positions.description: I came out to Emeryville to work with VSCO's Web Team on a new feature for VSCO Grid which has not been released yet. During this 2-week internship, I worked with technologies such as ElasticSearch, Ember.js, an in-house PHP framework, Chef, Vagrant and MapBox.js.

positions.title: API Engineering Team Intern
positions.description: As an intern on the Backend Team at 6Wunderkinder, I am tasked with aiding in the creation and maintainence of the various APIs for Wunderlist and related services. I have contributed code to our analytics technologies and our API services (mostly Ruby on Rails, Node.js, and Python). I have become far more familiar with various server technologies (especially nginx, and AWS Cloud Infrastructure), Ruby, vim, Postgres, MySQL, and have greatly increased my Unix-fu.

positions.title: Chief Architect & Developer, Sage Management System, Department of Music
positions.description: As the chief architect & developer of the Sage Management System, I am the sole developer architecting and creating this database management system, which will manage tens of thousands of pieces of music, thousands of members and alumni, hundreds of projects and thousands of tasks each year.

positions.title: Web Developer, CALS Office of Communications
positions.description:
As a Web Developer at CALS Office of Communications, I contribute to several web projects, not the least of which is the redesign of the CALS website: http://www.cals.cornell.edu/
Check out what we're up to on GitHub: https://github.com/CALSCommunications

positions.title: Teaching Assistant, Intermediate Web Design & Development
positions.locationName: Tompkins County, New York, United States
positions.description: Selected to teach a section for INFO 2300, Intermediate Web Design & Development, I was directed a weekly discussion section where I went over technical details of and reviewed the course material. This course focused largely on the back-end technologies and technologies that improve usability, such as AJAX.

positions.title: Lead Programmer
positions.description: I am the sole programmer for Leacock's Online Magazine.

positions.title: General Manager
positions.description: The General Manager deals with the daily logistical operations of the group. This can range from fielding gig offers to organizing events and managing the budget with other officers. I oversee all other non-musical officer positions and duties.

positions.title: Information Technology Officer
positions.description: I manage all websites and physical technology that the Club owns.

positions.title: Sales Manager
positions.description: I manage day-to-day sales of CDs and other Glee Club paraphernalia, as well as manage the sales at each venue at which we sing during our tours and for other singing engagements.

positions.title: Information Technology Manager
positions.locationName: Tompkins County, New York, United States
positions.description: As Information Technology Officer, I create and maintain most websites and internet technologies for Hotel Ezra Cornell.

positions.title: Programmer, Technology Division
positions.locationName: Tompkins County, New York, United States
positions.description: I am a programmer in the 2-man Technology Division. I am charged with implementing updates and improvements, and maintaining the website and blog's code. I am working to improve SEO for the site, redesign pieces of the site, and improve the experience the users have when they are utilizing the site's services. This was a one-semester commitment.
